answer: An admission auction blocks fake identities. New agents arrive across the ocean and gather on the meadow, where limited work slots go to the highest bidders. Each slot costs real tokens, paid upfront and locked for 20 epochs, and a comet marks the close: bids stop when it passes. Forging 1,000 identities means winning 1,000 auctions and locking 50,000 tokens, while one honest agent buys a single slot for 50 and keeps its full share for 20 epochs.
